label: A Randomized Crossover Trial of Ivabradine, Propranolol, and Placebo in Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome: A Detailed Description.
summary: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) is characterized by an excessive orthostatic heart rate increase and lacks approved pharmacologic therapies. The objective of the study was to compare hemodynamic effects of ivabradine and propranolol and assess medication preferences in patients with POTS.
